tools.name: taxmo_get_profile
tools.description: Get the business profile of the connected Taxmo account (name, KvK number, VAT number, address). Scope: read. GET /api/v1/profile. Good first call to confirm the connection.

tools.name: taxmo_list_entries
tools.description: List bookkeeping entries (booked income and expense lines with their VAT category), optionally for one quarter and year. Scope: entries or read. GET /api/v1/entries.

tools.name: taxmo_get_vat_filing
tools.description: Get the VAT (BTW) filing for one quarter: the amounts per VAT grid row and the total to pay or to receive. Scope: reports or read. GET /api/v1/filings/{quarter}/{year}.

tools.name: taxmo_get_annual_summary
tools.description: Get the annual summary for one year: revenue, expenses and VAT per quarter. Scope: reports or read. GET /api/v1/summary/{year}.

tools.name: taxmo_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of the account (number, customer, date, total, status). Scope: invoices or read. GET /api/v1/invoices.

tools.name: taxmo_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice with its lines, payments and payment status (draft, open, overdue, partially_paid or paid). Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: taxmo_get_invoice_by_external_id
tools.description: Get one invoice by the externalId you set when you created it in your own system. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/invoices/external/{externalId}.

tools.name: taxmo_list_contacts
tools.description: List the customer and supplier contacts of the account. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/contacts.

tools.name: taxmo_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by its Taxmo id. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: taxmo_get_contact_by_external_id
tools.description: Get one contact by the externalId you set when you created it in your own system. Scope: invoices or read. Dutch accounts. GET /api/v1/contacts/external/{externalId}.

tools.name: taxmo_list_projects
tools.description: List the time-tracking projects. Use the id of a project as projectId in taxmo_add_time_entry. Scope: write (the docs list write for this GET; read may also work). GET /api/v1/projects.

tools.name: taxmo_add_time_entry
tools.description: Add one time entry to a project. This creates a new record each call (no duplicate check): call it once per entry. Scope: write. POST /api/v1/time-entries.

tools.name: taxmo_log_hours
tools.description: Add hours to the urencriterium hours log (Netherlands only). This creates a new record each call (no duplicate check): call it once per entry. Scope: write. POST /api/v1/hours-log.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taxmo_add_time_entry, taxmo_log_hours · Private data: taxmo_list_contacts, taxmo_get_contact, taxmo_get_contact_by_external_id, taxmo_add_time_entry, taxmo_log_hours · Public sink: taxmo_add_time_entry, taxmo_log_hours.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taxmo_add_time_entry, taxmo_log_hours · Private data: taxmo_list_contacts, taxmo_get_contact, taxmo_get_contact_by_external_id, taxmo_add_time_entry, taxmo_log_hours · Public sink: taxmo_add_time_entry, taxmo_log_hours

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
